figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT customer_id,SUM(sales) AS total FROM orders WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT c.customer_id,COALESCE(t.total,0) AS total FROM customers c LEFT JOIN totals t ON c.customer_id=t.customer_id ORDER BY total DESC;

parts.label: 中间结果
parts.sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT customer_id,SUM(sales) AS total FROM orders WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id)
parts.note: 先单独算出一张临时结果 totals，下面的查询可以把它当作普通表来用。

parts.label: 取数
parts.note: 结果表最终显示 2 列：customer_id、total。

parts.label: 来源
parts.sql: FROM customers c LEFT JOIN totals t ON c.customer_id=t.customer_id
parts.note: 数据来自 表 customers、中间结果 totals，并用 ON 后面的条件把它们的行配起来。

parts.label: 排序
parts.note: 按 total DESC 排列结果。

figures.title: 为什么金额会被重复计算？

panels.label: 直接连接订单和联系记录
panels.note: 课文假设客户 1 有 3 次联系记录：每笔订单要和每一次联系各配成一行。

big.label: 直接求和得到的销售额

check.sql: WITH contacts AS (SELECT 1 AS customer_id,1 AS contact_no UNION ALL SELECT 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 1,3) SELECT SUM(o.sales) FROM orders o JOIN contacts c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.customer_id=1

panels.label: 订单本身的真实销售额

check.sql: SELECT SUM(sales) FROM orders WHERE customer_id=1

figures.conclusion: 每笔订单被联系记录各配一次，金额被放大成 3 倍（4200 ≠ 1400）。

figures.title: 如何避免重复计算？

check.sql: WITH contacts AS (SELECT 1 AS customer_id,1 AS contact_no UNION ALL SELECT 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 1,3) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contacts WHERE customer_id=1
SELECT SUM(sales) FROM orders WHERE customer_id=1

panels.label: 汇总后再连接
panels.note: 两张汇总表每位客户各只有一行，连接后仍是一行。

check.sql: WITH contacts AS (SELECT 1 AS customer_id,1 AS contact_no UNION ALL SELECT 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 1,3), c AS (SELECT customer_id,COUNT(*) n FROM contacts GROUP BY customer_id), o AS (SELECT customer_id,SUM(sales) total FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT SUM(o.total) FROM o JOIN c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.customer_id=1

figures.conclusion: 先把每张表汇总到“每位客户一行”再连接，金额只算一次，仍是 1400。
